SUGHRA nay sambhala ZAINAB ko,, SUGHRA ko sambhala ZAINAB nay

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ghar-lot-ke-ghar-mein-phla-dia.md')
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---')
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [len(block) for block in blocks] == [2, 3, 3, 3, 3]
    assert [block[0].strip() for block in blocks[1:]] == list(numbers)
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in meta and 'noUrdu' not in meta
print('Verified opening and four two-verse stanzas in both editions')
PY"
